decision: Owner decision #39 (2026-11-08): limited CLAUDE.md §9 exception for the non-official experiment Worker (P0-A2 phase 3, #156); Owner SAVE requirement (2026-11-08): minimal exception for local IndexedDB saves of non-official experiment worlds; Owner authorisation (2026-11-12, #156 phase 3): the P0-A2 24 h prototype core files run in the experiment Worker (candidate / experiment world, non-official, Owner #201)
label_zh: 非正式實驗世界／不屬於正式遊戲歷史

experimental_save_store.rule: Only these files may touch IndexedDB / StorageManager / Web Locks, only for databases whose name starts with the prefix, and only to store non-official experiment-world snapshots received from the Worker. They import only ./ viewer modules, never fetch or write anything else, and never touch saves/ or journal/.

node_verifier.decision: Owner ruling #200 (2026-11-12, option C): the world runs in the browser Worker; Node is an independent, reproducible verifier that recomputes with the SAME versioned core (no second science implementation).
node_verifier.rule: Only these cli/ files may import the Worker directory, and they import nothing else of the repository. They read one input file and print a report: no file-system writes, no child processes, no network, no official save / journal paths. They never produce official history.

deterministic_math_in_worker_graph.decision: Owner ruling #190 (scheme A: deterministic transcendental functions, ruled in #193, 2026-11-12), extended to exp / log / ** by the rules update detmath-exp: every module the Worker reaches must compute the same bits in every conforming ECMAScript engine, so the Node verifier (#200) reproduces a browser-advanced world.
deterministic_math_in_worker_graph.rule: In every module of the Worker graph, Math may only appear as Math.<allowed member> (IEEE-exact operations and constants; Math.random is forbidden separately), and ** only with a non-negative integer literal exponent. Implementation-approximated functions (exp, log, pow, sin, cos, tan, atan, atan2, asin, acos, sinh, cosh, tanh, asinh, acosh, atanh, cbrt, hypot, expm1, log1p, log2, log10, and ** with any other exponent) go through engine/clock/detmath.ts (detExp, detLog, detPow, detPowInt, detSin, detCos, detTan, detAsin, detAcos).

exempt_unreached_functions.reason: Box–Muller / Marsaglia–Tsang samplers of the official daily engine (golden-pinned, not changed here). The Worker graph never imports them; the checker verifies that no Worker-graph module imports these names or the whole module as a namespace, and that the rest of engine/rng.ts does not call them.

how_to_extend: Adding an allowed prefix or file (e.g. a new pure P0-A2 module) is a rules change: edit this file in its own PR, list the module's purity checks (pure_module_prefixes applies forbidden_in_engine_modules to it; tests/worker-boundary.test.ts adds negative fixtures) and get Owner authorisation. The Owner authorisation of 2026-11-12 (#156 phase 3) replaces the earlier 'Codex fixed-SHA review' step for this kind of change; CLAUDE.md §9 B still names the Codex review and is left for the Owner to update.
